sections.text:
-Target: 1 random enemy out of all enemies. Ability Power 260. Success value 100. 10x physical damage (Star).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: 1 random enemy out of all enemies. Ability Power 260. Success value 100. 10x magic damage (Star).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Success value 100. Blinds for 30 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Success value 100. Confuses for 30 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Nullifies Unison gauge reduction for 60 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Changes Cost held to 50. [Demerit]
-Target: yourself. Applies Dawn for 90 seconds (increases max HP and all stats by 100%; nullifies Cost reduction and Unison gauge reduction; recovers 10 Cost when using an Ability. When in effect and an enemy is defeated, recovers 30% of your max HP; applies Dual Attack; and debuffs/special debuffs are removed).
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 10000
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 10000
